0.5.2: The weight change predicted from calories now sits in brackets after the weekly calorie balance, for example +505 kcal (+0.05 kg).
The real weight change shows on its own with a scale icon and in the calendar’s weight colour.
0.5.1: Weekly balance, macros and weight indicators show in Firefox again.
The current week’s weight change now measures from last Sunday’s 14-day average to today, instead of from 7 days ago. The calorie prediction covers the same days.
0.5.0: Each week now shows how much the 14-day average weight changed over 7 days.

0.4.3: Weekly average balance now reads “xxx kcal” instead of “xxx kcal/day”. The tooltip still explains it is a daily average.
